title: These highlights do not include all the information needed to use TADALAFIL TABLETS safely and effectively. See full prescribing information for TADALAFIL TABLETS. TADALAFIL tablets, for oral use Initial U.S. Approval: 2003

sections.dosage_and_administration: Do not split Tadalafil tablets; entire dose should be taken.
